scope: Offline-only: DRM double-buffer/page-flip capability verification and userspace backend fix. No hardware boot, no camera, no visual claim about the black-square defect.
defect_context: UI_NAVIGATION_v1_RESULT.json: transient small black squares at bottom on frame changes, idle clean; cause not proven. Static risk: single active scanout buffer cleared/copied while display scans it.

driver_capability.method: static analysis of driver source and deployed module bytes
evidence: drm_vblank_init(drm, 1); drm_crtc_send_vblank_event on hc16xx_latched or after 4 vblank timeouts (flip_timeouts sysfs counter)
ping-pong layer descriptors: next_desc ^= 1, two descriptor slots per layer
deployed .ko contains drm_atomic_helper_page_flip, 'flip not latched after 4 frames', flip_timeouts, boot_descriptor strings
driver_capability.conclusion: Double buffering and synchronous page flip are supported by the kernel driver; the single-buffer limitation was in the userspace backend only.

backend_fix.change: Two dumb buffers + FBs. Scaler always renders into the inactive buffer; presentation via DRM_IOCTL_MODE_PAGE_FLIP with DRM_MODE_PAGE_FLIP_EVENT and a bounded DRM_EVENT_FLIP_COMPLETE wait matched by token. First frame and resynchronisation use SETCRTC + WAIT_VBLANK. After a failed flip the scanout target is unknown, so the next frame modesets before any render; the active buffer is never rewritten.
backend_fix.preserved: same exported ABI (video_drivers_init/video_driver_disp_frame/video_driver_deinit), same submitted_frames log format, trace header semantics (pixels = front), failed-restore retained-buffer cleanup

verification.native_mock: REAL_BACKEND_MOCK_DRM=PASS in QEMU build VM, gcc -std=gnu11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror
verification.mock_contract: mock hashes the active scanout buffer at every activation and aborts if the CPU rewrites it (regression guard for the defect); flip ioctl failure, flip event timeout and stale-event drain covered
verification.shared_library_contract: SHARED_LIB_CONTRACT=PASS: -DR36_BACKEND_TEST_LIBRARY .so exports the five symbols libretro_smoke dlsyms
verification.mips_mock_so_rebuild: done: rebuilt in QEMU build VM with mipsel-linux-gnu-gcc10.3.0 (see analysis/driver_port/DRM_FLIP_MIPS_REBUILD_v1_RESULT.json); driver_r36_test_mockdrm_v1.so now contains the flip fix

restrictions: no new hardware boot without explicit user readiness
no claim that the black-square defect is fixed until user observes it on hardware
